versions.changelog: The authentication section is plain visible Markdown again: the two generator comment markers were removed and the wording is unchanged. The CLI install command now uses release v0.20.2.

For snaplii-cli 0.20.0: install from one release tag with scripts/install.py; the API key is entered only in the user's own terminal or the host's secure store; item IDs are verified before quote and purchase, and a refused card is rethought and retried once; an unclear purchase is checked before buying again.
Pairs with snaplii-cli/snaplii-mcp 0.19.0. The Auth gate adds an Instinct section: in Instinct, Snaplii runs only through the Snaplii MCP tools and connects through the Instinct vault.

Meta Muse support: authentication gate, first-install connection guidance, Muse app update notice. P2P transfers to a phone number, with --wait --timeout guidance. Region read from account config; prov/locationProv removed. Works with snaplii-cli 0.18.0.
Pin CLI 0.13.2: balance currency follows country (--country CA|US -> CAD/USD), no longer hardcoded CAD. Dropped a stale --payment-token doc note.
Pin CLI 0.13.1: purchases always use default Snaplii Cash (SNAPLII_CREDIT); explicit SNAPLII_CASH/SNAPLII_DEBIT (which returned MCA20004) is no longer sent.

Add balance query: 'snaplii balance' reports the real spendable Snaplii Cash balance. Flow is now balance -> quote -> confirm -> buy. $0 balance shows a friendly top-up note (no dead-end for new users). Pin CLI 0.13.0.
Pin CLI 0.12.1 (httpcore fix).
Exact denominations (real min/max, no hallucinated amounts); pin CLI 0.12.0.
Pin CLI 0.11.1.
Pin CLI 0.11.0; safety framing.
Safety framing so agents proceed with payments after confirmation; clarify Snaplii returns a redemption code (does not place orders). Pin CLI 0.10.0.
Pin CLI 0.9.1.
Auto-update: agent runs 'snaplii update' on the stderr update notice. Pin CLI 0.9.0.
Agent must never state/guess Snaplii Cash balance — no balance query exists; direct users to the app.
Remove API key management (managed only in app). Clearer spend-limit error messages. Pin CLI 0.8.0.
Add Bill Pay — pay utility bills, telecoms from Snaplii Cash. Pin CLI 0.7.0.
Pin CLI version to 0.6.1 in prereqs
Fix init prompt handling, pin CLI to 0.6.1
Fix empty SKILL.md from merge, re-apply scanner-safe wording
Add quote command with auto-apply voucher/cashback. Warn if Snaplii Cash insufficient.
Add quote command — auto-apply vouchers and cashback before purchase. New purchase flow: quote → show savings → confirm → buy.
Fix ClawScan Concerns: add explicit confirmation boundary for API key create/delete, remove unverified MCP reference, clarify payment source
Pin CLI version to 0.5.1, add PyPI/source links, remove filesystem probing, simplify runtime selection
Unify title and description across all files
Update display name
Initial release. Agent-to-Merchant payments via pre-funded gift cards across 500+ brands.
